# ReleaseKit-Swift

> Zero-dependency Swift package (iOS 17+) that shows an automatic "What's new" sheet and an in-app changelog with votes and comments, powered by App Store release notes via releasek.it.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): one-shot integration steps for coding agents (add package, configure, modifier, settings link, verify)
- [README.md](README.md): overview, privacy label answers, configuration options

## Minimal integration
- Package URL: https://github.com/<OWNER>/ReleaseKit-Swift (from: 1.0.0), product `ReleaseKit`
- `ReleaseKit.configure(appKey: "rk_pub_...")` in `App.init`
- `.releaseKitWhatsNew()` on the root view
- `ReleaseKitSettingsLink()` in Settings
